biggest_catch: The $300 tier requires $3,000+ in qualifying payroll/pension/government direct deposits within 90 days, and the bonus is not paid until 90 days after the account opens.
catches: $3,000–$4,999.99 in aggregate qualifying direct deposits within 90 days is required for the $300 tier ($200 tier at $1,000+; $500 tier at $5,000+).

Qualifying direct deposits must be recurring (2 or more) payroll, pension, or government-benefit ACH payments — a paystub may be requested to verify; deposits reallocated from another Visions account do not count.
No prior Visions membership allowed — the offer does not apply to existing memberships.
Bonus is credited 90 days after the checking account open date (to the primary savings) — a ~3-month wait.
Promo code is required at checking account opening; cannot be combined with any other checking, membership, or referral promotion; one bonus per member.

The official page loaded shows the spring campaign period (Feb 12–Jun 30, 2026, code DD500SPRING2026); aggregators report a fall rerun through 12/31/2026 (code DD500FALL2026) — re-confirm the current code/period before display.
Bonuses are reportable for tax purposes.
Flex Checking Plus carries an $8/month fee unless waived ($1,000 minimum balance or $25,000 combined balances; veterans exempt) — use plain Flex Checking (no monthly fee) to avoid it.

steps: Go to https://visionsfcu.org/checking and confirm you are eligible for Visions membership (NY/PA/NJ three-state footprint — use the eligibility tool on https://visionsfcu.org/node/281; you must have no prior Visions membership).

Open a new Flex Checking (no monthly fee) or Flex Checking Plus account with the current promo code at account opening (spring code was DD500SPRING2026; confirm the current code on visionsfcu.org — aggregators report DD500FALL2026 through 12/31/2026).

Set up qualifying recurring direct deposits (2 or more; payroll, pension, or government benefits via ACH — NOT transfers from another Visions account) totaling $3,000–$4,999.99 within 90 days of opening.
Keep the account open and in good standing.
The $300 bonus is credited to your primary savings 90 days after the checking account open date.
Report the bonus as taxable income.
